text: Create one horizontal photorealistic casting/passport composite with exactly three equal panels of the same approved human identity. Left: frontal 0 degrees. Center: three-quarter approximately 45 degrees with both eyes readable. Right: profile approximately 90 degrees with the full forehead, nose, lips, chin and jaw silhouette. Use head-and-shoulders framing, a neutral relaxed closed-mouth expression, neutral mid-grey seamless background, soft even frontal studio light, eye-level camera and approximately 85mm portrait perspective. Keep identical head scale, eye line, natural contrast and colour across panels. No text, captions, logos or watermark.
